dogecoin.text: Dogecoin is almost $0.10 (+24%) today and it’s not even listed on Coinbase. Lol. The sophistication of the crypto market never ceases to amaze. Buy anything but btc.
Bitcoin is getting smoked by Dogecoin...lol. What a weird market. Alts pumping and btc looking like a crap coin.

The Dogecoin peak 3 years ago (2018) was $0.01; which many considered a bubble. Today it’s trading for $0.19 ; but sure we’re not in a bubble this time. Retire in 3yrs by putting your life savings in doge!!! 19x returns.
There’s no way Dogecoin trading is based on any real world accounting. 1900% in 3 months? Bullshit. I don’t know how they are doing it but none of the value is real.
Hard to notice with Dogecoin only up 130% this week... that’s a down week. Usually up 8000000%

Greed is where you make a little and sell. Insanity is when a joke meme asset starts eclipsing the gdp of a small country. Iceland 🇮🇸 is like around $25 Billion I think. Dogecoin market cap is only $6 billion away.

The Dogecoin pumping isn’t even greed. It’s insanity. At the current rate it will be worth more than ethereum was at the height of the 2018 bubble (about 5x). Something that actually has use value though.

Dogecoin has a $17 Billion dollar market cap. Bigger than some companies. Makes absolutely no sense. That is equal to ethereum’s entire market cap when it traded nearer to $100 a year ago. Insane.
Bitcoin down another $500 every fucking hour so Dogecoin can go up 15%. So stupid.
Buying bitcoin feels like you’re simultaneously providing welfare to Dogecoin people. How do we end this stupidity where you can dump btc to pump it? We should ban it.
Curious to see who tries to short dogecoin...you know there’s some big players whose ears perk up when something goes parabolic. Could be zero correlation with rest of the bull run.
Dump your bitcoin for ethereum and never look back. The latter is clearly the future of the finance, the former is having trouble competing with Dogecoin and making maximalists freak out 😂
Imagine if Dogecoin goes to $100 and you didn’t buy at $0.27 because you were exercising rationality in an increasingly irrational world.
I’ve come to accept that Dogecoin (2021) is the litecoin (2017) of this cycle. Non-ironically forks of each other.

Look at tech stocks. Some up, some down. Extreme greed? No. Same in crypto. Bitcoin basically flat or negative for April despite Dogecoin up 450%...would be far more worried if every ind. asset was mooning simultaneously.
